summary: Implemented capability admission and a local default-deny runtime gateway for filesystem writes and command execution.

implemented_components.name: CapabilityAdmissionService
behavior: requires request expiry to be in the future
denies unsupported high-risk network, secret, external write and production deploy actions
requires approval refs for R2/R3 or high-risk actions
intersects requested resources with Goal scope and Policy scope
requires runtime support and exact command allowlist membership for process execution
denies planner, verifier and reviewer filesystem write grants by default
enforces spawn limits from the tighter Goal/Policy maximum
emits a narrower CapabilityGrant only on allow

implemented_components.name: LocalRuntimeGateway
behavior: checks grant action, plan, node, role, expiry and supersession before side effects
blocks path traversal and symlink escape outside the workspace root
blocks writes outside granted globs before writing
blocks shell metacharacter substitution and commands outside grant resources before execution
audits every allowed or denied filesystem write and command attempt

implemented_components.name: CapabilityAdmissionPort and RuntimeGatewayPort
behavior: define provider-neutral interfaces for admission and side-effect gateway calls
avoid domain-layer dependency on model, workflow, cloud or sandbox SDKs

default_deny_matrix.case: unsupported high-risk network or secret capability

provided: default-deny gateway checks before local filesystem writes and command execution
workspace path containment for normal paths, traversal attempts and symlink escapes where the OS exposes symlinks
exact command allowlist and shell metacharacter rejection
audit records linked to plan, node and policy decision
not_provided: containment for code that bypasses the gateway
